head: shara
matrix_event: ëna lukhela wërawë-te, terayaro bobala-m shiwari-te sha shara dëru-te
english_event: person who called yesterday left before sunrise
lexical_decisions: Voice call noun bobala sent by shiwari encodes placing a voice call, not just exchanging text.
The explicit sunrise-begin event anchors the earlier-than relation.
The subject gap of relative clause is filled by shara; the embedded relative is not another speaker.
conditional_sense: meeting begins late; new late manner use for yuwule with inchoative start
causal_sense: office had become closed before the departure; not every office is a public business

head: shenaro
matrix_event: pëhezho rëgë-te sha shenaro aru shërawëro-te
english_event: machine repaired by engineer stopped working again
lexical_decisions: The gap is the machine repaired, not the engineer.
Inanimate machine shërawëro gains specialized cease-operating sense, not merely stop moving.
conditional_sense: team inspect electrical wiring, licensed new machinery-inspection object subtype

head: zemobo
matrix_event: relomo-mi-m taro-te sha zemobo tarowa marao-lo shënariwo-te
english_event: dog following cyclist waited near bridge
lexical_decisions: Cyclist is licensed occupation/person-role relomo-mi, not the bicycle itself.
tarowa marao-lo selects vicinity of bridge, not location literally inside it.
The dog is the subject gap in followed-the-cyclist.
causal_sense: the road was busy; no assertion that traffic injured the dog

head: shiwaro
matrix_event: ëna bohona shiwaro-m bokhenu-te, bohona bokhenu-te sha shiwaro shiwari-li-te-mo
english_event: message deleted by moderator had already been forwarded
lexical_decisions: The message is object gap of the deletion relative.
Forwarded means previously retransmitted, editorial narrow sense of shiwari; the preposed ëna clause marks forwarding before deletion.
The passive forwarded message does not identify or invent an actor.
causal_sense: message disclosed private data; message as source of disclosure, not an identified human author

head: shërawoho
english_event: medicine requested by patient was unavailable
lexical_decisions: Restricted patient request of specific treatment substance, not generic information request.
The relative gap is the medicine, not the patient.
The main state is unavailability and not permanent prohibition.
conditional_sense: doctor would propose an alternative medicinal substance, not necessarily approve its use
causal_sense: shipment delayed; passive without agent does not identify who caused delay
